# php-sql-mysql-decided-offset-partial-repository-commits

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories with their own SQL through PDO and services, in PHP 8.4. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mysql.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take an array of the fields that change.
- Transactions: every repository write is committed at once.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/Database.php             the PDO connection to DATABASE_URL
src/Sql.php                  how the repositories run SQL: values and refusals
src/UnitOfWork.php           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/Entities/                one entity per table
src/Repositories/            the repositories of each table
src/Services/                one service per table
tests/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json           what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
composer install
TEST_DATABASE_URL="mysql://app:app@localhost:3306/app" vendor/bin/phpunit   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A page of a list: the rows from an offset, and how many there are in all.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Page
{
    /** @param list<T> $items */
    public function __construct(public array $items, public int $total, public int $offset, public int $limit)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The same page with every row turned into something else.
     *
     * @template R
     * @param callable(T): R $mapper
     * @return Page<R>
     */
    public function map(callable $mapper): self
    {
        return new self(array_map($mapper, $this->items), $this->total, $this->offset, $this->limit);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use PDO;

/** The database DATABASE_URL names, through PDO. */
final class Database
{
    public const DEFAULT_URL = 'mysql://app:app@localhost:3306/app';

    /** The URL of DATABASE_URL, or the default one. */
    public static function url(): string
    {
        $url = getenv('DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : self::DEFAULT_URL;
    }

    /** A connection to the database at $url (DATABASE_URL when null). */
    public static function open(?string $url = null): PDO
    {
        $url ??= self::url();
        $parts = parse_url($url);
        if ($parts === false || !isset($parts['host'], $parts['path'])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The URL of the database is not valid');
        }
        $dsn = sprintf('mysql:host=%s;port=%d;dbname=%s;charset=utf8mb4', $parts['host'], $parts['port'] ?? 3306, ltrim($parts['path'], '/'));
        return new PDO($dsn, rawurldecode($parts['user'] ?? ''), rawurldecode($parts['pass'] ?? ''), [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_NUM,
            // Numbers come back as numbers
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
        ]);
    }
}

    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "tags" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Tag $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['label'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('label', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('label', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 30) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('label', 'is longer than 30 characters');
            }
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Tag', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Tag $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Tag $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('label', $values)) {
            $entity->label = $values['label'];
        }
    }

    /** The Tag with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, int $id): Tag
    {
        return $uow->tags->getById($id) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Tag', $id);
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field: only the fields of the table that can change.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $changes
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(array $changes): array
    {
        return array_intersect_key($changes, array_flip(['label']));
    }

    /** Stores a new Tag after checking it. */
    public function createTag(Tag $tag): Tag
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'label' => $tag->label,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values, $tag): Tag {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            return $uow->tags->insert($tag);
        });
    }

    /** The Tag with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getTag(int $id): Tag
    {
        return self::find($this->uow, $id);
    }

    /**
     * A page of tags, by primary key.
     *
     * @return Page<Tag>
     */
    public function listTags(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        return $this->uow->tags->list($offset, $limit);
    }

    /**
     * Changes the given values of a Tag.
     *
     * @param array{label?: string} $changes
     */
    public function updateTag(int $id, array $changes): Tag
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): Tag {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return $uow->tags->update($current);
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a Tag. */
    public function deleteTag(int $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            $uow->tags->delete($current);
        });
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use PDO;
use PDOException;
use PDOStatement;

/** What the repositories run their SQL with, over PDO: statements and their values, and the database's refusals. */
final class Sql
{
    /**
     * Every row of a query, as the list of its columns.
     *
     * @param list<mixed> $values
     * @return list<list<mixed>>
     */
    public static function all(PDO $db, string $sql, array $values = []): array
    {
        return self::run($db, $sql, $values)->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_NUM);
    }

    /**
     * The first row of a query, or null.
     *
     * @param list<mixed> $values
     * @return list<mixed>|null
     */
    public static function one(PDO $db, string $sql, array $values = []): ?array
    {
        return self::all($db, $sql, $values)[0] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Runs a statement with its values, in order.
     *
     * @param list<mixed> $values
     */
    public static function run(PDO $db, string $sql, array $values = []): PDOStatement
    {
        $statement = $db->prepare($sql);
        foreach ($values as $index => $value) {
            $statement->bindValue($index + 1, $value, match (true) {
                $value === null => PDO::PARAM_NULL,
                is_int($value) => PDO::PARAM_INT,
                is_bool($value) => PDO::PARAM_INT,
                default => PDO::PARAM_STR,
            });
        }
        $statement->execute();
        return $statement;
    }

    /** Whether the database refused a write: a unique value taken, a row still pointed to, a value against its rules. */
    public static function isRefusal(PDOException $error): bool
    {
        // SQLSTATE class 23 (integrity constraint violation), or a CHECK of MySQL (3819) or MariaDB (4025)
        return str_starts_with((string) $error->getCode(), '23') || in_array($error->errorInfo[1] ?? null, [3819, 4025], true);
    }
}

namespace Tests;

use App\Database;

/** The test database: the MySQL database TEST_DATABASE_URL names, created from the schema before every test. */
final class TestDatabase
{
    /** Removes every table, so the database starts empty */
    private const DROP = [
        'SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 0',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `audit_log`',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `product_tags`',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `tags`',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `order_lines`',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `orders`',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `products`',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `categories`',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `customers`',
        'SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 1',
    ];

    /** Creates every table, in an order the database accepts */
    private const CREATE = [
        'CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `email` VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `created_at` DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `uq_customers_email` UNIQUE (`email`)
)',
        'CREATE TABLE `categories` (
  `id` BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE (`name`)
)',
        'CREATE TABLE `products` (
  `id` BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `category_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `name` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `price` DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  `status` VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  `version` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `deleted_at` DATETIME(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CHECK (`price` >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_products_category` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `categories` (`id`)
)',
        'CREATE INDEX `ix_products_status` ON `products` (`status`)',
        'CREATE INDEX `ix_products_category_id` ON `products` (`category_id`)',
        'CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `customer_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `placed_at` DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`)
)',
        'CREATE TABLE `order_lines` (
  `order_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `line` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `product_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `quantity` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`, `line`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)',
        'CREATE TABLE `tags` (
  `id` BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `label` VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
)',
        'CREATE TABLE `product_tags` (
  `product_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `tag_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`, `tag_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`tag_id`) REFERENCES `tags` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
)',
        'CREATE TABLE `audit_log` (
  `at` DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  `message` TEXT NOT NULL
)',
    ];

    public static function url(): ?string
    {
        $url = getenv('TEST_DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : null;
    }

    /** The repositories over the test database, with every table dropped and created again. */
    public static function open(): SqlUnitOfWork
    {
        // The tables are written for one kind of database: the tests cannot fall back to SQLite
        $db = Database::open(self::url() ?? throw new \RuntimeException('The database tests need a disposable MySQL database: set TEST_DATABASE_URL (it is emptied)'));
        foreach ([...self::DROP, ...self::CREATE] as $sql) {
            $db->exec($sql);
        }
        return new SqlUnitOfWork($db);
    }
}
